categories.name: Antiperspirant Sticks
categories.description: SAVA antiperspirant sticks: clinical sweat control with refined, long-lasting fragrance.

products.name: Sava Kinetic
products.description: Sava Kinetic is built on one promise: to keep up with you. Its dual-action formula controls sweat and neutralises odour where they start, while Silver Lining — bright citrus peel and cool mineral notes over a clean musk — unfolds slowly through the day. It glides on clear and stays comfortable from the first commute to the last rep.

additionalInfo.title: Benefits
additionalInfo.description: Advanced sweat control with a crisp, energising scent, made for days that don't slow down.

additionalInfo.title: Key Ingredients
additionalInfo.description: A sweat-control complex with skin-conditioning botanical oils and time-release fragrance micro-capsules. Free from paraben preservatives, denatured alcohols and artificial dyes.

additionalInfo.title: Aroma
additionalInfo.description: Silver Lining: bright citrus peel and cool mineral notes over a clean musk.
